title: Buy a domain
summary: Purchase a domain end-to-end: pay via Stripe, register at Name.com, auto-connect DNS/SSL via Cloudflare.

parts.title: Register and pay at your registrar
parts.guidance: Match the checkout to the chosen domain, registrar, registration term and company registrant. Check the final charge and renewal settings against the purchaser's authorization; resolve any changed terms before payment. Complete registration and required contact verification, then confirm the domain appears in the company-controlled account. Save the receipt with the renewal contact and settings.

options.title: Default — Register and pay at your registrar
options.summary: Use the selected registrar's current checkout. Check the exact spelling, company registrant, term, final charge, renewal preference and extension restrictions against the authorized purchase. Resolve any checkout difference that changes that decision. After payment, complete required contact verification and confirm the domain is in the intended account, with the receipt and renewal details available to its owner.

verify.how: An RDAP/WHOIS lookup shows the domain registered to you (or your registrar's privacy proxy) with the expected expiry date.

cost.note: Registration prices vary by TLD and registrar — at-cost registrars publish wholesale pricing; no single sticker price exists.

execution.rationale: Name.com documents selecting the domain, checking its cart and completing the approved registration purchase. Verify the account's resulting domain, contact details and renewal arrangement.

options.title: Cloudflare Registrar (at cost)
options.summary: Cloudflare Registrar requires Cloudflare nameservers; a requirement to use another DNS provider rules out this option. Check the selected domain's availability and live registration and renewal quote. Complete the authorized purchase and required contact verification, saving the receipt and renewal settings. Confirm the domain appears as registered in the intended account.
options.when: DNS already runs on Cloudflare - at-cost registration, no markup

execution.rationale: Cloudflare Registrar documents domain search, purchase and nameserver requirements for this explicit provider method.

parts.title: Provision DNS/SSL
parts.guidance: Inspect the existing DNS zone, then use the website host's current instructions to identify the required records. Apply the domain administrator's agreed changes without disturbing email or other services. Verify hostname resolution, the live HTTPS certificate and the chosen root-to-www redirect. Report the observed results and any verification still pending.

verify.how: The domain resolves from public DNS and loads over HTTPS with a valid certificate.

execution.rationale: Cloudflare DNS is documented; the chosen origin's certificate provisioning and redirect controls are not established.

metadata.supportReason: Registrar, payment, and DNS APIs cover the whole purchase — quote, register, and provision run end to end.
